explanation_bands.name: VERY LOW
explanation_bands.description: No GitHub presence or only very basic repositories.
explanation_bands.improvement: Build meaningful contributions to other people's projects.

explanation_bands.name: LOW
explanation_bands.description: Minimal open-source activity or only a basic GitHub presence.
explanation_bands.improvement: Make meaningful contributions to external open-source projects.

explanation_bands.name: MEDIUM
explanation_bands.description: Contributions to smaller open-source projects or meaningful open-source activity.
explanation_bands.improvement: Increase the depth, consistency, and impact of contributions.

explanation_bands.name: HIGH
explanation_bands.description: Significant contributions to established open-source projects or substantial community involvement.
explanation_bands.improvement: Demonstrate sustained, substantial contributions and greater community impact.
